title: First Making Tax Digital quarterly update due
summary: The first quarterly update under Making Tax Digital for Income Tax (covering 6 April to 5 July 2026) must reach HMRC by 7 August 2026.
who: UK sole traders and landlords with qualifying income over £50,000
notes: Subsequent updates due 7 November 2026, 7 February 2027 and 7 May 2027.

title: All French companies must be able to receive e-invoices
summary: From 1 September 2026 every company registered in France must be able to receive electronic invoices (facturation électronique) via the official platform network.
who: All VAT-registered businesses in France, regardless of size
notes: Issuing obligation phases in later; large and mid-sized companies must also issue from this date.
